release.notes:
## What's Changed
- Support Android16 QPR1
- Support auto start without root on Android13+ when connected to a trusted WiFi
- Update the start command
```sh
pm_path=$(pm path moe.shizuku.privileged.api) && apk_path=${pm_path#package:} && $(dirname $apk_path)/lib/*/libshizuku.so
```
You can copy `libshizuku.so` file to any executable location, such as /data/local/tmp/shizuku

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/RikkaApps/Shizuku/compare/v13.5.4...v13.6.0
